title: Midday Sunwatch
text:
🌤️ Midday Sunwatch — October 23, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Low (B5.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: B7.6 (Peaked October 23, 2026 at 14:03 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 422 km/s (Moderate)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: Quiet (Kp 2.67)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Electron 2MeV Integral Flux exceeded 1,000pfu

Things are buzzing a bit in near-Earth space! 📡🔌🌞

Images: NASA SDO/AIA — 193, 335, 171, 304, 131, 94 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
